biotools.summary: FuncPhos-STR is a web server for functional prediction and structural visualization of human proteome-level phosphosites. It integrates AlphaFold protein structures, sequence evolution, and protein-protein interaction information to predict phosphorylation sites and their potential regulatory mechanisms.
